author: Viggo8816
quote: Fake reviews from critics. This game is not made for GTA fans and is insulting. Doing chores and simping for Lucia who is unlikable and a terrible person. The game gives you no freedom on your relationship with her (which is the overwhelming main focus of the game) and forces you to play the way they want you to. GTA 6 is the most overhyped and overrated game of all time and the huge world and amazing graphics are ruined by -30 fps and one of the worst and unsatisfying stories in any game ever. It focuses more on realism by forcing you to go shopping and make coffee tables then it does having fun.
